title: WCC: A Learning-Based Framework for Deciding When to Apply Cooperative Coevolution in Large-Scale Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.37329v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cooperative Coevolution (CC) and Non-Decomposition Algorithms (NDAs) are two primary approaches for large-scale global optimization (LSGO). Although both have achieved success, they exhibit markedly different performance across problem types and each faces approach-specific limitations, leaving the question of "when to use CC" unresolved. We address this gap with WCC, a novel learning-based framework that dynamically decides when to deploy CC in LSGO. WCC employs a streamlined design for efficient adaptive learning. We formulate the decision as a Markov decision process, designing a targeted feature set, a robust reward, and a tailored network architecture to provide the agent with rich information about the problem state and optimization progress. Our auto-regressive policy enables WCC to perform fine-grained, dynamic switching between CC and NDAs while conditionally allocating the computational budget without expert specifications. W

translated_title: WCC：一种用于决定何时在大规模优化中应用协同进化的基于学习的框架
translated_abstract: 协同进化与非分解算法是大面积全局优化的两种主要方法。尽管两者都取得了成功，但它们在不同问题类型上的表现差异显著，且各自面临方法特有的局限性，这使得“何时使用协同进化”这一问题仍未得到解决。我们提出了WCC——一种新颖的基于学习的框架，用于动态决定何时在大规模全局优化中部署协同进化。WCC采用精简的设计以实现高效的自适应学习。我们将该决策问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程，设计了有针对性的特征集、稳健的奖励函数以及定制的网络架构，为智能体提供关于问题状态和优化进度的丰富信息。我们的自回归策略使WCC能够在协同进化与非分解算法之间进行细粒度的动态切换，同时无需专家指定即可有条件地分配计算预算。
tldr: WCC是一个基于学习的框架，通过将算法选择决策建模为马尔可夫决策过程，在大规模优化中动态决定何时使用协同进化或非分解算法，实现细粒度的动态切换与计算预算的自适应分配。
en_tdlr: WCC is a learning-based framework that formulates algorithm selection as a Markov decision process to dynamically decide when to apply cooperative coevolution versus non-decomposition algorithms in large-scale optimization, enabling fine-grained switching and conditional computational budget allocation without expert specification.
